name: @occluze/tether-sync
description: Shopify -> Webflow CMS sync for Tether: webhooks, reconcile cron and initial import. Runs as a Cloudflare Worker or a Node CLI.
author: Ravi Klaassens

WEBFLOW_COLLECTION_ID.description: Id of the Webflow Products collection (collection settings in the Webflow CMS).

WEBFLOW_TOKEN.description: Webflow site API token with **CMS read and write** (Site settings → Apps & integrations → API access).

SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Client id of a Shopify [Dev Dashboard](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/dev-dashboard) app installed on your store, with `read_products`. Enter `none` if you use SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN.

SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of that app. Also used to verify webhooks. Enter `none` if you use SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN.

SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Only for an existing admin-created custom app: its `shpat_…` token. Otherwise `none`.

SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Only for webhooks created under Settings → Notifications: the signing key shown there. Otherwise `none` (the client secret is used).

SYNC_SECRET.description: A long random string. Protects `/check` details and `POST /reconcile`.

FIELD_MAP.description: Optional JSON to change the field mapping, e.g. `{"material":"metafield:custom.material"}`. Otherwise `none`.
